provenance: Original wording authored for this project from independent semantic summaries; numerical scoring and option order are separate source facts.

hardy-q1: A difficult exam is a week away. How do you spend that week?
Save the studying for the final evening.
Have fun and leave the books alone.
hardy-q2: When a subject fascinates you, can you give it your full attention?
I can stay with it for ages.
hardy-q3: A task turns out to be much tougher than expected. What now?
Keep working until I make progress.
Leave that challenge to someone else.
hardy-q4: You're filling an empty bucket. Where do you stop?
docile-q1: Two wrapped gifts are waiting, one big and one small. Which catches your eye?
docile-q2: An old egg cracks open in your room. What do you do first?
Lean closer to find out how bad it smells.
docile-q3: A friend brings back something you forgot. How do you respond?
Let them know I appreciate the help.
Thank them with a playful joke.
docile-q4: You notice a wallet lying on the pavement. What is your first response?
Take it to someone who handles lost property.
Feel thrilled about my lucky discovery.
Look around to see who's watching.
brave-q1: A bungee cord snaps during a practice drop with a dummy. Would you still take your turn?
I'd go ahead with the jump.
I'd give the jump a miss.
brave-q2a: Visitors from space are attacking your town. How do you react?
Carry on as if nothing happened.
brave-q3: Someone sounds frightened behind a closed door. What do you do?
Pull the door open at once.
brave-q4: You see someone being harassed on a busy street. How do you respond?
Step in even though I'm shaking.
Find someone in authority to help.
jolly-q1: How would you describe your usual mood?
jolly-q2: A loud celebration is bringing everyone together. Does that sound fun?
I'd love to join the crowd.
jolly-q3: You can choose a summer getaway. Where would you head?
To the coast for some fun.
I don't mind where we go.
jolly-q4: A visitor chats to you in a language you don't understand. Your response?
Ask them to explain another way.
Bring the conversation to an end.
impish-q1: Have you ever made a hidden hole as a prank?
impish-q2: How do you feel about playful pranks?
I get a kick out of them.
They aren't my kind of fun.
impish-q3: Think of all the things you'd like to try. How long is your list?
Only a few things come to mind.
impish-q4: A bully is picking on your friend. What would you do?
Go straight up and confront the bully.
Call out a warning from a safe distance.
Hide and make fun of the bully.
naive-q1: Someone tells a wonderfully terrible pun. How does it land with you?
I love that sort of joke.
naive-q2: Is laughter a regular part of your day?
I laugh at all sorts of things.
naive-q3: Do people often say you act younger than your age?
I hear that quite a lot.
That isn't something people say about me.
naive-q4: Do you enjoy inventing little adventures in your imagination?
I can happily entertain myself that way.
timid-q1: A strange hand suddenly rises from the toilet bowl. What is your reaction?
Lower the lid as quietly as possible.
timid-q2: Use your right hand to choose one finger on your left. Which one did you pick?
timid-q3: The lights go out and you're stuck in a room. What do you do?
timid-q4: People say an empty house is haunted. Would you explore it?
I'd be too scared to enter.
I'd go with someone I really like.
hasty-q1: A gift has just arrived for you. How do you approach it?
Tear into the wrapping right away.
Leave it unopened for a while.
Ask someone else to open it.
hasty-q2: A lottery ticket brings you a big prize. What would you do with the money?
Give the winnings to a good cause.
hasty-q3: You find an old treasure chest. What is your first thought?
I can't wait to look inside.
There could be something dangerous in there.
hasty-q4: Your friend hasn't arrived at the agreed time. What do you do?
sassy-q1: You have a chance to speak to your country's leader. How would you sound?
Like their position doesn't impress me.
sassy-q2: Do people ever ask you to be more careful with your words?
People don't usually tell me that.
sassy-q3: Do you see yourself as someone others find cool?
I think I make quite an impression.
I wouldn't describe myself as cool.
sassy-q4: When you feel grateful, can you say so sincerely?
I can tell people what their help means to me.
calm-q1: Would you call yourself so careful that you can seem a little dull?
calm-q2: Would a quiet life with very little to do suit you?
calm-q3: Do you enjoy getting into fights?
calm-q4: Do you catch yourself yawning often?
relaxed-q1: How often do you arrive late for school or appointments?
relaxed-q2: Has your usual pace become slower lately?
I feel as though I've slowed down.
My pace feels much the same.
relaxed-q3: It's a lovely day beside the sea. How are you feeling?
Excited to make the most of it.
relaxed-q4: Do you sometimes fall asleep without meaning to?
lonely-q1: How do you tend to feel when you're on your own?
I start wishing someone were with me.
I'm comfortable with my own company.
lonely-q2: Everyone has left the classroom except you. Does that bother you?
I dislike being the last person there.
I'm happy to stay by myself.
lonely-q3: What lighting do you prefer when you settle down to sleep?
I'd like a light to stay on.
lonely-q4: You have free time, but none of your friends is available. What next?
Go out and do something on my own.
Pass the time without making plans.
Stay in and feel down about it.
quirky-q1: Do you sometimes find yourself with no idea what to do next?
I can usually think of another activity.
quirky-q2: When a new message arrives, what do you usually do?
Reply when the mood takes me.
Leave it because replying feels like a chore.
quirky-q3: You rarely get a chance to talk to someone you like. How would you use the next chance?
Get their attention with a bit of mischief.
Watch from a distance without approaching.
quirky-q4: At a fork in the road, a stranger points toward buried treasure. Which way do you go?
Distrust the advice and go the other way.
Pick either route without a preference.
misc-q1: What sort of company would you like on a holiday?
I'd enjoy travelling on my own.
I'd like friends to come along.
misc-q2: A festival is coming to town. Are you interested?
I'm looking forward to the festivities.
It doesn't make much difference to me.
misc-q3: Someone says your unusual habits make you entertaining. How do you take it?
I'm pleased they enjoy my odd side.
I'd rather they hadn't described me that way.
brave-q2b: The invaders defeat you, then offer you a place beside them in power. Your answer?
Accept their offer and join them.

results.hardy: You keep putting one foot in front of the other. Your steady effort can help a team through a difficult day.
results.docile: You make room for other people and their ideas. That willingness to listen can turn strangers into companions.
results.brave: You are willing to act when something matters. Courage can mean taking a step even while you feel afraid.
results.jolly: You bring a little brightness wherever you go. Shared laughter can make a long journey feel shorter.
results.impish: You notice opportunities for a little mischief. Your lively ideas can keep your friends guessing.
results.naive: You find delight in small and unexpected things. That open curiosity gives familiar places a fresh look.
results.timid: You notice danger and take your feelings seriously. A trusted companion can help you find the next safe step.
results.hasty: When an idea catches you, you want to get moving. Your energy can help a team make its first move.
results.sassy: You have your own point of view and aren't quick to hide it. Speaking honestly can be a gift when you also listen.
results.calm: You value a little breathing room. Your quiet presence can help others gather their thoughts.
results.relaxed: You are comfortable letting the day unfold. Your unhurried pace can remind a busy team to rest.
results.lonely: Connection matters to you. A familiar voice and a shared journey can mean more than a grand destination.
results.quirky: You don't always follow the expected path. An unusual idea may help your team notice something everyone else missed.
